title: CEFR Listening Mock 16
description: Rasmiy formatdagi CEFR Listening mock testi — 6 part, 35 savol.
subject: Ingliz tili

sections.instruction: You will hear some sentences. You will hear each sentence twice. Choose the best reply to each sentence.
sections._note: Audio har bir gapni ikki marta o'qiydi, shuning uchun play_limit = 1.

sections.title: Reading Competition
sections.instruction: You will hear someone giving a talk. For each question, fill in the missing information in the numbered space. Write ONE WORD and / or A NUMBER for each answer.
sections.passage:
Reading Competition

  • The reading competition lasts from June to {{9}}
  • The participants must read at least {{10}} books.
  • The competition finishes at {{11}}
  • To take part in the competition, you must register by {{12}}
  • Top prize for the winner is {{13}} pounds.
  • For further information, our email address is {{14}}

sections.instruction: You will hear people speaking in different situations. Match each speaker (15-18) to the statement (A-F). There are TWO extra statements you do not need to use.

bank.instruction: 15-18 spikerlarni A-F fikrlaridan mos kelganiga ulang. Ikkitasi ortiqcha.

options.A: Taking natural trips to recover stress
options.C: Learns from observing animals and their behavior
options.D: Nature photography to share online moments
options.E: I want to take pictures of animals at the zoo
options.F: Became interested in nature after a special outdoor activity

sections.instruction: You will hear someone giving a talk. Label the places (19-23) on the map (A-H). There are TWO extra options which you do not need to use.
sections._note: Xarita rasmi shart: A-H nuqtalari o'sha rasmda ko'rsatilgan bo'ladi.

bank.instruction: 19-23 joylarni xaritadagi A-H harflari bilan belgilang. Ikkitasi ortiqcha.

sections.instruction: You will hear three extracts. Choose the correct answer (A, B or C) for each question (24-29). There are TWO questions for each extract.

choices.C: On stage at a book festival.

questions.body: What do the speakers agree about, regarding Ali Ball's book Cold Spies?

choices.A: It would not make a good film.
choices.C: It is better than his previous one.

questions.body: Extract two. What does the lawyer think?

choices.B: The prosecution won't have any evidence.

choices.A: Ann will lose her driving licence.

questions.body: Extract three. What's the purpose of the conversation?

sections.title: DOMESTICATION OF WILD LIONS
sections.instruction: You will hear someone giving a talk. For questions 30-35 complete the sentences with a word.
sections.passage:
